function entry(input, output, safety, argv, source, bugs = []) {
  return {
    sections: [{ title: 'Input Contract', text: input }, { title: 'Return Contract', text: output },
      { title: 'Prerequisites And Safety', text: safety }],
    examples: [{ label: 'Documented invocation', argv, requires: 'Use existing names from discovery unless this command explicitly creates them. All remote examples require a configured backend and Fusion; no example is run by help.', output }],
    audit: { sources: [source, 'src/cli.js:parseFlags,parseCommand,main'],
      verified: ['positional and flag parsing', 'selector and scope rules', 'output and failure branches', 'prerequisites, defaults and state changes', 'example argument dispatch'],
      tests: ['tests/legacy.test.js', 'tests/registry.test.js', 'tests/manual-legacy.test.js', 'tests/manual_legacy_test.py'], gaps: [], bugs },
  };
}
const cloud = 'Uses the active hub. Project lookup selects the FIRST exact case-sensitive project name, not an ID. Folder paths are relative cloud names separated by /; empty segments are ignored (not filesystem paths). File lookup selects the first exact display name or display name plus .extension. Discover with projects, folder_list and tree. No duplicate-name disambiguation, rollback, overwrite prompt or automatic retry. Cloud availability/permissions and SDK errors can still prevent execution.';
const design = 'Requires --doc and an open Fusion Design document. Legacy lookup requires one case-insensitive name match, successful activation and matching active document identity. Names inside the design are exact case-sensitive, not token refs. These scripts are submitted as potentially mutating, including read-style commands; finish interactive commands first. No automatic save or rollback; inspect after failure. For exact unique scoped JSON inspection use the corresponding CAD commands.';

manuals.run.sections[0].text += ' --out PATH writes a CLI-local file (relative to cwd); its parent must already exist and be writable, and any existing destination, including a dangling symlink, is refused before execution. --out-format text|json defaults to text and requires --out. --pretty true|false requires --out and --out-format json; default false. Output file options cannot be combined with --list/-l.';
manuals.run.sections[1].text += ' Terminal output remains backend text plus the existing CLI-added newline, regardless of --out/--pretty. Text files contain exact UTF-8 backend out.text, excluding that added newline. JSON files contain a whole parsed JSON value, or the JSON value following exactly one line-start FMCAD_RESULT marker amid diagnostics (marker and value on the same line). Missing, multiple or malformed markers fail rather than produce an empty object. JSON is compact by default or two-space indented with --pretty true, with a final newline. Raw results are not diagnostic-redacted. Backend failure preserves the existing raw stdout/failure contract and publishes no requested output file.';
manuals.run.sections[2].text += ' File publication uses a complete fsynced temporary file and exclusive hard-link publication, followed by directory fsync; existing files/symlinks/hardlinks are never replaced, including collisions appearing during execution. Only the publisher-owned temporary file is cleaned up. Publication/JSON conversion failure returns nonzero and never retries the script: Fusion may already have changed. A failure after the publication link (for example directory fsync) can leave a complete output file with durability unconfirmed; inspect before rerunning. Filesystem hard-link and directory-fsync support is required.';
